issue.title: Expose artifact-link origin support as a probeable sase-core capability
issue.description:
Proposed by phase bead sase-1tz.3.1.1 (prose_wire, epic sase-1tz.3.1) as PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP #2; filed by the sase-1tz.3.1 land agent.

Today a newer sase running against an older, still-in-window sase-core-rs rejects every `prompt_prose` artifact-link row with a serde "unknown variant" error on every publication pass. sase-1tz.3.1.1 added `ArtifactLinkOriginWire::PromptProse` plus an exhaustive `ALL` list in sase-core (09391374), and sase's contract test `tests/sdd/test_artifact_link_host_origins_contract.py` round-trips `ARTIFACT_LINK_HOST_ORIGINS` (`src/sase/sdd/artifact_link_origins.py`) through the binding. That catches drift at the CI pin only. `tools/probe_core_floor` detects missing binding *names*, not enum variants, so it cannot see install skew where the loaded binding lacks an origin.

Proposal:
1. In sase-core, expose `ArtifactLinkOriginWire::ALL` through a binding (for example `artifact_link_origin_names()`).
2. In sase, have `tools/probe_core_floor` and/or a `sase doctor` check (and optionally the publication job) compare `ARTIFACT_LINK_HOST_ORIGINS` against that list and fail fast with "installed sase-core-rs lacks origin X; update" instead of a per-pass serde error.
3. Ratchet the published sase-core-rs floor past the release that contains PromptProse once one ships.
Move `sase-core-revision.txt` past the sase-core commit (docs/rust_backend.md).

task_type_fields.proposal: Expose ArtifactLinkOriginWire::ALL through a sase_core_rs binding, check ARTIFACT_LINK_HOST_ORIGINS against it in tools/probe_core_floor and/or sase doctor, and ratchet the sase-core-rs floor past the PromptProse release.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Epic sase-1tz.3.1 scoped prose_wire to adding the variant plus a CI-pin contract test; install-skew capability probing is a separate cross-repo floor feature.
